_comment: Tier-2 for fenics heat#5: a UFL Form cannot be divided by a fem.Constant. `u * v * ufl.dx / dt` divides the FORM, not the argument. The fixture triggers it and prints the TypeError verbatim, then shows the two documented spellings that work. Mutation control: T2_MUTATE=1 divides the argument instead of the form. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 on dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology and the fixture then fails its own expectations.
